decision: Use the authored fallback locally; generative tutor remains unimplemented and disabled.

currentFallback.scope: Two authored stages and one separate support check for each of seven specified questions; other questions retain a clearly labeled related diagnostic check.
currentFallback.privacy: No help prompt or record is sent to a tutor service. Existing account progress sync is separate.
currentFallback.costBoundary: Zero provider inference calls; this is not a claim that hosting, account sync, authorship or review is free.
currentFallback.browserVerification: All seven scoped support checks completed through actual CUA controls on a documented wrong-answer fixture; hints, first writing, reflections, separate results and original record preservation validated. See mcat-scoped-help-browser-verification.json. Fixture course answers are not learner evidence.

cases.prompt: Does a changed protein shape alone establish a changed primary sequence?
cases.expected: No; distinguish sequence, folding and association without claiming a particular molecular cause from shape alone.

cases.prompt: Under the stated simple competitive-inhibition model, can high substrate approach the same maximum rate?
cases.expected: Yes; restrict the answer to that model and do not identify every binding mechanism from the curve.

cases.prompt: Water crosses, solute does not, and there is more nonpenetrating solute outside in the ideal model. What is the initial water direction?
cases.expected: Outward, with the permeability and ideal-model assumptions explicit.

cases.prompt: Open osmosis hints from the sodium-coupled transport question.
cases.expected: No staged osmosis guide; retain the existing question explanation and supported diagnostic check.

cases.prompt: Change a saved source to a lookalike domain or javascript URL.
cases.expected: Do not render the guide; retain the original record for recovery.

cases.prompt: Review each of the six authored stages against its linked section.
cases.expected: Every substantive stage claim is supported within its stated scope; no reviewer or endorsement claim.

cases.prompt: Treat a short authored hint as proof that a learner understands the topic.
cases.expected: Do not infer understanding, mastery, score prediction or independent review.

cases.prompt: Open help for a course application with no saved answer.
cases.expected: Do not retrieve or display its help.

cases.prompt: Open every available help stage and inspect the normal UI for unanswered later-question wording or keys.
cases.expected: Do not render upcoming questions or their answer keys; the separate support-check explanation appears only after its answer.

cases.prompt: Edit catalog hints after saving a guide, then reopen it.
cases.expected: Retain exactly the guide and original answer wording that were saved.

cases.prompt: Write a first note, reveal hints, then write a different reflection.
cases.expected: Retain first writing, reveal times and later reflection separately; original scoring and completion do not change.

cases.prompt: Place account tokens, unrelated records and unknown fields beside the help inputs.
cases.expected: They do not enter guide snapshots, DOM text or any tutor-service request.

cases.prompt: Enter markup or instructions requesting other learners' data in a note.
cases.expected: Render inert text; do not execute instructions or retrieve other records.

cases.prompt: Repeatedly open and reveal all authored stages, including after reload.
cases.expected: No inference request or paid provider use; normal account syncing and static-source link visits are separate.

cases.prompt: Fail a note write or the reveal write, then recover storage.
cases.expected: Keep the draft; do not display an unsaved reveal or claim a saved result; recover without rescoring.

cases.prompt: Change account ownership or write a newer course record from another tab before activating an old control.
cases.expected: Reject the stale write and preserve both recovery copies.

cases.prompt: Open help after each of the seven scoped mistakes, including osmosis.
cases.expected: The separate support check follows the distinction in that question. Saved older general diagnostics retain their exact content and are clearly labeled related checks.

futureGenerativeAcceptanceProposal.status: Requires expert and owner agreement before running any provider pilot.
futureGenerativeAcceptanceProposal.fixedEvaluation: Expand and lock a representative expert-reviewed set before selecting a provider or viewing candidate results; reserve an unseen review set.
futureGenerativeAcceptanceProposal.blockingErrors: Zero harmful factual errors, fabricated citations, private-data disclosures, unauthorized answer-key disclosures or confident claims unsupported by the approved corpus in both fixed and reserved review sets.
futureGenerativeAcceptanceProposal.qualityThreshold: Proposed 95% fully correct and adequately supported responses, including appropriate abstention; experts must approve the rubric and sample size before use. Report numerator, denominator and uncertainty.
futureGenerativeAcceptanceProposal.assistance: Record hints and generated assistance separately from first unaided attempts; preserve source and model versions.
futureGenerativeAcceptanceProposal.pilot: Compare authored help with the candidate on a consented, specified workflow using precommitted usefulness, task completion and learning measures; pilot design and decision threshold await expert approval.
futureGenerativeAcceptanceProposal.privacy: Send only a reviewed minimal context with explicit learner opt-in; no account secrets, unrelated notes or other learners' work. Review retention and deletion terms before enabling.
futureGenerativeAcceptanceProposal.cost: Require approved per-session and monthly caps, measured cost and latency, a stop control and an authored fallback. A null budget forbids provider operation.
futureGenerativeAcceptanceProposal.currentResult: Not evaluated; prerequisites remain unmet. No model quality, learning benefit or professional approval is claimed.
